title: 3rd Truth The Importance Of This Mystery And Reference To The Risale I Nur

questions.question: What big truth is this passage talking about?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and His power over everything.

questions.question: What does the passage say this truth helps open for us?
questions.answer: It helps open the deep meanings of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does it help people understand about creation?
questions.answer: It helps them understand a very hard secret about how all things are made.

questions.question: What does the passage say about philosophy when facing this secret?
questions.answer: It cannot solve it by itself.

questions.question: Who is thanked and praised in the passage?
questions.answer: The Compassionate Creator, Allah.

questions.question: What book is said to explain and prove this truth?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: How sure does the passage say these proofs are?
questions.answer: Very sure, like a simple math fact.

questions.question: Did the writer plan to explain everything in full here?
questions.answer: No. Only the basic parts were going to be shared briefly.

questions.question: How many mystery-steps are mentioned?
questions.answer: Thirteen.

questions.question: How many of those had already been written?
questions.answer: Two.

questions.question: Why was the rest not finished?
questions.answer: Two hard obstacles stopped it.

questions.question: What important belief is called a great foundation of Islam in this passage?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What kind of secret does the passage say is very hard for human minds to reach alone?
questions.answer: The secret of how Allah creates all things, big and small, with the same ease.

questions.question: What writing is said to have explained this secret clearly?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: Why is so much praise given to Allah in the passage?
questions.answer: Because Allah allowed this hard truth to be explained and shown.

questions.question: Was the whole subject going to be fully explained here or only the basics?
questions.answer: Only the basics.

questions.question: What picture is used for the thirteen mysteries?
questions.answer: They are like thirteen steps or a table of contents.

questions.question: What stopped the writing after the first two mysteries?
questions.answer: Two strong obstacles, one physical and one not physical.

questions.question: In the First Mystery, what cannot come into Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Weakness cannot come into it.

questions.question: What makes things have different levels, like brighter or dimmer?
questions.answer: The mixing in of the opposite.

questions.question: What opposite makes light seem weaker?
questions.answer: Darkness.

questions.question: What opposite makes heat seem less?
questions.answer: Cold.

questions.question: If nothing blocks Allah’s power, what does that mean about creating?
questions.answer: Nothing is difficult for Him to create.

questions.question: Which is harder for Allah, making a flower or bringing a great resurrection?
questions.answer: Neither is harder. Both are easy for Him.

questions.question: How does the passage compare Allah’s making of a tree and a flower?
questions.answer: Both are made with skill and care.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about big and small things before Allah’s power?
questions.answer: They are the same in ease.

questions.question: What does the passage say is a great source of faith?
questions.answer: Understanding Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What mystery is described as a very great and helpful wisdom?
questions.answer: That the biggest things and the smallest things are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What does understanding this mystery help a person know?
questions.answer: A hidden secret about creation.

questions.question: According to the passage, what cannot solve this secret well enough?
questions.answer: Philosophy.

questions.question: Which work is said to have solved and proved this mystery?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: How strong are the proofs said to be?
questions.answer: They are very strong and certain.

questions.question: Did the writer finish all thirteen mysteries in this place?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What was the writer able to complete before stopping?
questions.answer: The first and second mysteries.

questions.question: Why is Allah’s power never weak?
questions.answer: Because weakness cannot touch His perfect Essence.

questions.question: Why do some created things have stronger and weaker levels?
questions.answer: Because opposites affect them.

questions.question: Since Allah’s power has no weakness in it, what can stop it?
questions.answer: Nothing can stop it.

questions.question: What big event is said to be as easy for Allah as springtime?
questions.answer: Resurrection.

questions.question: What is said to be as easy as making a flower?
questions.answer: Making a tree.

questions.question: What is one main point of this passage about Allah and creation?
questions.answer: Allah creates all things with perfect ease and power.

questions.question: What does the passage say this teaching opens from the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Its hidden treasure-like meaning.

questions.question: Why is this teaching important for Muslims?
questions.answer: It is a deep base for faith and belief in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What book besides the Qur’an is praised for explaining this matter?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What feeling fills the words of praise in the passage?
questions.answer: Thankfulness to Allah.

questions.question: How many mystery-points were meant to be mentioned?
questions.answer: Thirteen.

questions.question: Why were all of them not written there?
questions.answer: Obstacles prevented the rest.

questions.question: What is the first basic truth about Allah’s power in the First Mystery?
questions.answer: Its opposite, weakness, cannot enter it.

questions.question: How do we get different amounts of strength in ordinary things?
questions.answer: By resistance and other opposites affecting them.

questions.question: Does Allah’s power have that kind of weakness mixed into it?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: So what is the result when Allah creates things?
questions.answer: No obstacle can make creation hard for Him.

questions.question: Which is easier for Allah: reviving the world, bringing spring, growing a tree, or making a flower?
questions.answer: All are equally easy for Him.

questions.question: Does the passage say Allah makes only small things beautifully?
questions.answer: No. He makes big and small things beautifully.

questions.question: What does the easy and beautiful coming of many living things show?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s unity and power.

questions.question: What do these creatures leave after they go?
questions.answer: Their seeds.

questions.question: In the Second Mystery, what shining thing is the first example?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: How can one sun be seen in many places?
questions.answer: Its light reflects in many mirrors and drops.

questions.question: What does one word entering many ears help us understand?
questions.answer: That one act can reach many without becoming harder.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about one and many for Allah?
questions.answer: One and many are the same for His power.

questions.question: Why is it natural in the passage that Allah creates countless things easily?
questions.answer: Because His power is endless and all things obey His command.

questions.question: What happens to the earth in spring that is like being raised again?
questions.answer: It is brought back to life with many kinds of living things.

questions.question: What secret about Allah’s power is highlighted at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The biggest and the smallest are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What does this secret help uncover?
questions.answer: A hidden mystery of creation.

questions.question: What human way of thinking is said to become helpless before this mystery?
questions.answer: Philosophy.

questions.question: To whom is deep praise given?
questions.answer: To Allah, the Compassionate Creator.

questions.question: What work is thanked for explaining this mystery with proof?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What simple comparison is used to show how certain the proof is?
questions.answer: A basic math truth.

questions.question: What was the writer planning to give after pointing to bigger sections of that work?
questions.answer: A short list of foundations and proofs.

questions.question: What happened to that plan?
questions.answer: It stopped after two mysteries because of obstacles.

questions.question: In the First Mystery, why can Allah never be powerless?
questions.answer: Because powerless weakness cannot touch His Essence.

questions.question: What general rule is taught by the examples of light, heat, and strength?
questions.answer: Differences happen when opposites get involved.

questions.question: What does that mean about difficulties and barriers?
questions.answer: They cannot block Allah’s power.

questions.question: What four examples are compared to show equal ease?
questions.answer: Resurrection, spring, a tree, and a flower.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah shows in front of our eyes?
questions.answer: He makes all these things with skill and ease.

questions.question: What would become hard without Divine unity according to the passage?
questions.answer: Even making a flower, a tree, or a living creature.

questions.question: Why do living things come out into the world in such a regular way?
questions.answer: Because Allah creates them with art, ease, and order.

questions.question: What two things do these creatures do before leaving?
questions.answer: They do their duties and glorify Allah.

questions.question: What remains after they leave?
questions.answer: Seeds remain.

questions.question: In the Second Mystery, what quality lets one source appear in many places?
questions.answer: A light-like reflective quality.

questions.question: How are all created things described before Allah’s command?
questions.answer: They are obedient and submissive.

questions.question: What does the passage say about many jobs happening at once for Allah?
questions.answer: They do not interfere with each other.

questions.question: How does the passage show Allah gives life broadly in spring?
questions.answer: He gives life to one creature, whole groups of creatures, and many plants and animals with ease.

questions.question: What central belief is called one of the greatest bases in this passage?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What special idea about Allah’s power is explained here?
questions.answer: For Allah, creating something huge is no harder than creating something tiny.

questions.question: What holy book’s deep meaning is said to be opened by this explanation?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What mystery of creation is said to be made known?
questions.answer: How all beings are created by Allah’s power.

questions.question: What way of thought is said to be unable to master this mystery?
questions.answer: Philosophy.

questions.question: What book is named as giving strong proofs for this matter?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: How many mysteries were going to be pointed to?
questions.answer: Thirteen.

questions.question: Which ones had already been written?
questions.answer: The first and the second.

questions.question: What prevented the others from being written?
questions.answer: Two strong obstacles.

questions.question: In the First Mystery, what can never reach Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Weakness.

questions.question: What simple lesson do light and darkness teach in the passage?
questions.answer: Opposites can make things seem more or less strong.

questions.question: What simple lesson do heat and cold teach?
questions.answer: Levels happen when an opposite is mixed in.

questions.question: Since Allah’s power has no weakness mixed into it, what is true?
questions.answer: It has no weak level and no deficiency.

questions.question: What follows from that when Allah creates?
questions.answer: Nothing can make creation difficult for Him.

questions.question: Which is said to be as easy as bringing spring?
questions.answer: The great resurrection.

questions.question: Which is said to be as easy as making a flower?
questions.answer: Making a tree.

questions.question: What does the beauty and abundance of living things point to?
questions.answer: Allah’s perfect power and unity.

questions.question: What do these creatures do in the world?
questions.answer: They carry out their tasks.

questions.question: What do they leave behind for those after them?
questions.answer: Seeds.

questions.question: In the Second Mystery, what does one sun shining in many mirrors help explain?
questions.answer: That one source can act in many places at the same time.

questions.question: What does one word reaching many ears show?
questions.answer: One action can reach many without becoming harder.

questions.question: What does the passage say about small and big, or few and many, for Allah’s power?
questions.answer: They are all the same for His power.

questions.question: What springtime example near the end shows a kind of resurrection?
questions.answer: Allah brings the earth back to life and raises many kinds of living things with ease.
